faq_heading: New construction in Richmond: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Richmond where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Richmond?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were condos in Hamilton RI: median build year 2026, 27 sales, median price $587,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Richmond?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was condos in Broadmoor: 16 days to sell at a median, closing at 95.9% of the list price.

blocks.text: What newer homes in Richmond have sold for
Over November 2025 to October 2026, the newest homes to close in Richmond were condos in Hamilton RI: a median build year of 2026, 27 sales and a median price of $587,000.
2 of 59 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Hamilton RI condos (built 2026) and Bridgeport RI townhomes (built 2020).

items.t: Hamilton RI condos: 27 sold at a median of $587,000 (middle half between $539,950 and $659,950), taking 32 days at 99.2% of the list price, with a median build year of 2026. The typical home had 2 bedrooms, it sold for about $724 per square foot, strata fees were a median $420 a month and 4% of the sales closed over the list price.
